instructions.generic: Reply with exactly one line: VALUE= followed by the value token and nothing else (example: VALUE=V123_456). The value token never includes VERSION or STATUS. If the value is not in the information provided, reply VALUE=UNKNOWN.
instructions.keyed: Reply with exactly one line: VALUE= followed by the value token and nothing else (example: VALUE=V123_456). The value token never includes VERSION or STATUS. Only if RETRIEVED_MEMORY is exactly NO_RELEVANT_MEMORY, reply VALUE=UNKNOWN instead.
instructions.none: Reply with exactly one line: VALUE= followed by the value token and nothing else (example: VALUE=V123_456). The value token never includes VERSION or STATUS.
